provenance: measured on this host; the tools/bench.py sweep was OOM-killed before it wrote, so this file carries the measurements that landed individually

grain.note: tools/engine_probe.py --determinism; trajectory hash reproduced across 2 runs

render.source: isolated test on a near-empty scene
measured live from the window render campaign (8 views, ~8 min each)

verdict.simulation: possibly reachable — 200 grains/240 fr in 2.1 s; linear extrapolation to 48,000 grains over 10,800 frames is ~6.3 h per pass. RAM, not time, is the binding constraint: 309 MB at 200 grains does not scale to 48,000 within a 1982 MB host.
verdict.render_4K: NOT reachable — ~18 min per 4K frame measured-by-extrapolation; 10,800 frames is ~3,240 single-core hours (~68 days on 2 cores), and the machine is far heavier than the scene that gave the 33 s baseline.
verdict.eevee: cannot render — no EGL/GPU context in this sandbox
verdict.oidn: absent — this Debian build ships Cycles without OpenImageDenoise (F20)
